subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `deferred` as a public cron/run status and expose yielded-parent lifecycle helpers/callbacks through the plugin-facing surfaces in this PR?
rationale: The runtime bugfix is plausible, but the branch adds persisted protocol values and SDK/hook contracts that are compatibility-sensitive and cannot be approved by source inspection alone.

options.title: Require Rebase, Proof, And Contract Signoff
options.body: Resolve conflicts, add Discord-visible and upgrade proof, and merge only after maintainers explicitly accept the public `deferred` and lifecycle SDK contract.

options.title: Split Public Contract From Runtime Fix
options.body: Keep a narrower yielded-parent runtime repair and move the public status/SDK contract into a separate maintainer-owned design PR.

options.title: Accept Contract Risk After Conflict Resolution
options.body: Maintainers can merge after rebase on the current cron proof alone, but that owns downstream compatibility and unproven Discord behavior risk.

recommendation.title: Require Rebase, Proof, And Contract Signoff
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, add Discord-visible and upgrade proof, and merge only after maintainers explicitly accept the public `deferred` and lifecycle SDK contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows work across cron delivery, subagent registry, and Discord monitor paths, which span the contract and runtime decision.
